column1: # Constellation Arabic Engine — Layer 2 protected list.
# This file is the authoritative source for words the analyzer must
# never decompose. Loaded via `include_str!` at compile time; zero I/O
# at runtime. Append-only: duplicates are first-write-wins, so reordering
# or pasting an already-present entry is always safe.
#   surface     The Arabic surface form. MUST be stripped of tashkeel
#               variants (أ إ آ ؤ ئ) MUST be preserved — they are root
#               letters. The normalizer strips tashkeel before lookup, so
#               users who type a vocalized form will still match.
#   category    One of: proper | place | loanword | function.
#               - loanword — non-Arabic word adopted into Arabic.
#   origin_lang BCP-47 code: ar, de, en, es, fa, fr, he, hi, ja, ko,
#               pt, ru, tr, ur, zh. Use '-' for None (native Arabic or
#               an origin we don't carry in the 15-language bridge).
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
# Selection criteria (the bar for adding an entry):
#   1. The surface would be over-stripped by a Light10-class stemmer OR
#      decomposed by our FST into something semantically wrong.
#   2. The word is high-frequency enough to appear in real user text.
#   3. It is genuinely non-decomposable — there is no (root × pattern)
#      analysis because the word isn't derived from an Arabic root.
# Source provenance: hand-curated from public-domain references and
# common-knowledge. No BAMA / Buckwalter / SAMA content. Entries that
# would eventually be sourced from Wikipedia CC BY-SA extraction are
# marked with a `# wp:` comment near the section header.
# Ramp target (M1g/M1h full): 20K proper nouns + 2K loanwords. Today's
# file ships ~1000 hand-picked entries across all categories — enough to
# make the analyzer behave correctly on common text while the full
# Wikipedia-driven pipeline is built out in lab/ (separate milestone).
# Classical + modern. Selected for prefix-collision risk (و / أ / م / ال)
# and corpus frequency. Many are traditional / religious-heritage names.
# Flagship regression case — Light10 over-stripped وائل → ائل.
# Expanded set (M1g) — common modern + classical male names.
# PROPER NOUNS — Transliterated Western / international names
# Common renderings in modern Arabic press and social media.
# PROPER NOUNS — Political / historical figures (modern references)
# Expanded Arab cities — major governorate capitals and landmarks.
# origin_lang marks the primary language of the country, used by the
# lexical bridge for automatic cross-language links.
# Too short or too irregular for safe morphological analysis.
